description: Removes C2PA 'Made with Claude' credentials, EXIF, XMP, ICC, and all other metadata from images. Supports JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, TIFF. Free to use, no API key required. Returns the cleaned image as a downloadable file.

image_url.description: URL of the image to strip metadata from

name: strip_image_metadata
title: Strip metadata from images (C2PA, EXIF, XMP)
